title: JCDL 2026 · SafeLens Best Demo Award
location: Frisco, Texas · ACM/IEEE Joint Conference on Digital Libraries
body: SafeLens received the conference’s Best Demo Award. The work is authored by Sanjay Das, Ryan Burchfield, Gavin Wiggins, Alan Guy, and Tirthankar Ghosal, with research support from Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

title: 3rd AI4Ops Symposium
body: ORNL will organize the third AI4Ops Symposium in 2027. Exact dates, venue, program, and registration details will be added when announced.

title: 2nd AI4Ops Symposium
body: PI Dr. Tirthankar Ghosal and ITSD colleagues presented and demonstrated in-progress AI for Laboratory Operations tools.
